name: Configure Motor Imagery Channel Protocol from EEG Recording
description:
You are a BCI research scientist analyzing EEG data for a neural prosthetics study investigating motor imagery signals. You have a 8-channel EEG recording where the electrodes are placed at positions Fp1, Fp2, C3, C4, P7, P8, O1, O2 in channel order (channel 1 through 8 respectively).

The recording file ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings/OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt is a real EEG recording from the PhysioNet Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset. Load this file in Playback mode and configure OpenBCI GUI for motor cortex analysis:

- Load the Motor Imagery recording file in Playback mode
- Disable all channels that are NOT over motor cortex — only the C3 and C4 electrode channels should remain active; disable all others (Fp1, Fp2, P7, P8, O1, O2 channel positions)
- Set the bandpass filter to the Mu + Beta motor imagery band (8–30 Hz)
- Add the FFT Plot widget to a display panel to monitor the frequency spectrum
- Save the session configuration to a settings file

This protocol allows analysis of motor cortex ERD/ERS patterns while excluding contamination from frontal, parietal, and occipital channels.

metadata.recording_source: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (eegmmidb 1.0.0), Subject S001
